samples.excerpt:

== Ụzọ e si eje ozi ==
A na-ahụkarị Abunuabunu ma kwadebe ya n'etiti ndị mmadụ na Kumasi. A na-ejikarị akpu ma ọ bụ banku enye ya mana enwere ike inye ya ihe ọ bụla ị họọrọ.

samples.title: Aframomum corrorima
samples.excerpt:
Aframomum corrorima  bụ ụdị osisi ifuru na ezinụlọ ginger,    Zingiberaceae. Ọ bụ herbaceous  perennial   nke na-emepụta akwụkwọ ndụ akụkụ ndụ 1-2 mita n'ogologo nke mgbọrọgwụ  rhizomatous.  Akwụkwọ ndị a haziri ahazi bụ akwụkwọ ndụ  gbara ọchịchịrị,10–30 cm long and 2.5–6 cm n'ofe, elliptical ka ọ toro ogologo n'ọdịdị ya. Ọ na-ebu ifuru pink n'akụkụ ala ma na-enye ohere nye mkpụrụ na-acha uhie uhie, mkpụrụ osisi anụ ahụ nwere mkpụrụ aja aja na-egbuke egbuke, nke na-adịkarị 3–5 mm na dayameta.

samples.title: Aletta E. Schutte
samples.excerpt: Aletta E. "Alta" Schutte bụ ọkachamara n'ọrịa ọbara mgbali elu na ọrịa obi dabere na Sydney, Australia. Ọ bụ Prọfesọ SHARP na Isi Okwu Nduzi nke Ọrịa obi, Vascular na Metabolic Medicine na Mahadum New South Wales na Sydney, yana nhọpụta nkwonkwo dị ka onye otu Prọfesọ na George Institute for Global Health. Ruo n'afọ 2019 ọ bụ onye isi otu ụlọ ọrụ nyocha ọbara mgbali elu na Africa (HART), Onye isi oche nyocha South Africa (SARChI) na onye isi ngalaba nke Medical Research Council Extramural Unit maka ọbara mgbali elu na ọrịa obi na Mahadum North-West na South Africa. samples.title: Amanda Chetwynd
samples.excerpt:
Amanda G. Chetwynd PFHEA bụ onye Britain na-eme mgbakọ na mwepụ nakwa onye na-ahụ maka ọnụ ọgụgụ nke ngalaba ọkachamara ya bụ na combinatorics na ọnụ ọgụgụ mbara igwe. Ọ bụ Prọfesọ nke mgbakọ na mwepụ na ọnụ ọgụgụ na Provost maka ahụmịhe ụmụ akwụkwọ, kọleji na ọbá akwụkwọ na Mahadum Lancaster, nakwa onye òtù ndị isi nke Higher Education Academy . 


== Agụmakwụkwọ na Nnyocha ==
Chetwynd nwetara nzere Ph.D. site na Mahadum Open n'afọ 1985. Anthony Hilton na Robin Wilson jikọrọ aka lekọta edemede ya, Edge-colourings of graphs. O mere nnyocha onye nwetarala nzere ọkankuzi ya na Mahadum Stockholm

Ndị na-eto eto n'agbata afọ iri na ụma nwere okwukwe ụfọdụ ya, mana ọ na-ewepụ na-ekwu ma ọ bụ na-ahụ Abom.
